```sql
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_jul_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-08-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-09-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_aug_2025,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-08-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-09-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END))
   * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-08-01' THEN product_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items"
WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-07-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-09-01';
```
